Across LA County, nonprofits need volunteers, and plenty of people want to help. They rarely find each other. Causematch fixes that.
Post an opening once. Volunteers nearby who care about your cause swipe right. You say yes, and after the shift one tap confirms their hours.

say: A nonprofit joins first. Jordan asks for access with the organization's name and tax ID.

caption: An admin checks the request. Jordan signs in from an emailed link: no password.
